The module screens name every page three times before the data starts, then spend a fourth line explaining a word that needed no explaining. This sheet is the rule that stops it — and it is not new: the teacher portal already works this way.
What a destination page says today
Accounting › Receivables, drawn at the top of the page. Every band below names the same destination.
customers, invoices and the money coming in
names the page — the only place it is named
unchanged — it already marks the spot
The band keeps its height and loses its words. What fills it is the thing a name could never tell you — how much is open, how much is late — and it stays pinned while the rows scroll under it.
Every screen on this canvas is drawn against these. They apply to all modules, not just this one.
The caption line is not deleted — it is repointed
It stops explaining the title and starts carrying the state that changes. This is the teacher portal's rule, lifted verbatim.
Where nothing changes, there is no caption. A page whose only context is its own name gets a title and nothing else — that is most of them.
This is already shipped code, not a proposal.
dropped its category line for exactly this reason — “it repeated what the rail already says” — and spends its caption on the term and the class in view.
props. The admin modules are what has not caught up.
